title.romaji: Aikatsu! 10th STORY: Mirai e no STARWAY

Media.description: The main leads Ichigo Hoshimiya and Akari Oozora in their debut outfits as the Cosmos duo (from the television series finale). The film's story introduction reveals that the first live Cosmos concert was a great success. Later, Ichigo faces her graduation from Starlight Academy in half a year — but even after graduation, the life of an idol continues.

node.description: The fourth season of Aikatsu! continues on from season 3 with an introduction a brand-new idol unit from Hokkaido.

Aikatsu Planet! The Movie is the movie adaptation of Aikatsu Planet! series. Screened alongside the movie Aikatsu! 10th STORY: Mirai e no STARWAY.

Mao Otoha, who is now a second year high school student at Seirei Private High School, is now performing as the top idol Hana in Aikatsu Planet!

A few months after the Planet Princess Grand Prix, her schedule is packed everyday. The reason why Mao can be an active idol is because of the bond she has with her fans, in which she has changed and felt touched, and now would like to deliver her gratitude to those important around her by launching the "Aikatsu Planet! Gratitude Festival".
